name: Rinkan Gakkou 3 ~Kendou Shoujo Kanraku Rape~
original_name: 輪姦学校3 ～剣道少女陥落レイプ～
source:
Yui Natsukawa is an active girl belonging to a kendo club. She has a strong sense of justice and that makes her a target of a group of rogues that rape girls as they want.
